thread_id.note: v3 integer id, forum.ts:275. v4 uses the session NAME as a string (A3) -- a deliberate change, not a v3 field.

message_count.note: threadData.messages.length BEFORE the limit slice, forum.ts:278 -- v3 never returns a short count even when `limit` truncated the array

notes: v3 has NO `seq` field and NO `next_cursor` field on this tool. V3-PARITY.md §4.2 documents both as v4 additions.
